newsitem.title: USA: High Plains contracts with new grain buyer.
newsitem.headline: High Plains contracts with new grain buyer.

text.p: High Plains Corp said Friday it contracted with Centennial Trading LLC to source and purchase grain.
It said Centennial replaces Farmland Industries Inc's Grain Division as the primary grain strategist and purchasing agent.

Centennial will provide consultation to the company in market projections and risk management strategies, and will source grain for the Colwich, Kan. plant. Grain for the York, Neb. plant will be sourced primarily by High Plains employees in cooperation with Centennial.

Chief financial officer Raymond Friend said Farmland performed well for High Plains, but "hiring Centennial will allow the company to take a more active role in the sourcing of its grain requirements, while still retaining the advantages of having a contracted grain purchasing agent familiar with High Plains."

Friend said the company expects the arrangement to lower its overall grain costs by allowing more flexibility in grain origination and to realize freight savings through more direct control of the trafficking.
